summary:
Space exploration leaves behind more than scientific discoveries. Every lunar and Martian landing creates a trail of discarded equipment, including parachutes, heat shields, descent stages and other hardware that helped spacecraft reach the surface.

BEYOND THE LANDING is an interactive digital museum that explores these forgotten objects and the stories behind them. Through visual storytelling, landing-sequence explanations, an interactive object archive and a Moon-versus-Mars comparison, the project reveals what remains after a successful landing. Using real NASA mission examples, including the Apollo lunar missions and Mars 2020 Perseverance landing, it highlights the engineering, challenges and scientific significance of these objects.

Our goal is to transform forgotten landing hardware into meaningful stories, helping people understand the history and legacy of space exploration.

Every landing leaves a story.
details: BEYOND THE LANDING – Stories Left Behind by Space Exploration 1. Introduction Space missions are remembered for their discoveries, astronauts, rovers and scientific achievements. However, an important part of every landing mission often receives less attention: the equipment left behind on the surface. From heat shields and parachutes to descent stages and landing structures, these components play essential roles in delivering spacecraft safely to the Moon and Mars. Once their tasks are completed, many remain on the planetary surface. BEYOND THE LANDING aims to tell their stories. 2. Our Solution We developed an interactive digital museum that presents the history and purpose of discarded space exploration equipment through an accessible website. Instead of treating these objects as ordinary debris, the platform explains their engineering purpose, their role in successful landings and their contribution to the legacy of space exploration. 3. Main Features - Interactive Landing Sequence: Explore the different stages of a planetary landing, from approach and atmospheric entry to powered descent and surface arrival. - Object Archive: Discover equipment such as heat shields, backshells, parachutes and descent stages. - Moon and Mars Comparison: Understand how landing systems differ between lunar and Martian missions. - NASA Mission Examples: Explore examples from the Apollo lunar missions and Mars 2020 Perseverance landing. - Knowledge Check: Test understanding through an interactive quiz. - NASA References: Access NASA resources to explore the mission evidence further. 4. Why This Project Matters Every discarded component represents a successful engineering task and an important moment in the history of space exploration. By documenting these objects, we aim to make space exploration more understandable, engaging and memorable, especially for students and young space enthusiasts. 5. Expected Impact BEYOND THE LANDING encourages people to look beyond the main spacecraft and appreciate the engineering systems that make planetary exploration possible. It provides an educational experience that connects mission technology, historical achievements and scientific curiosity. 6. Conclusion Space exploration does not end when a spacecraft touches the surface. The objects left behind continue to tell the story of the journey. BEYOND THE LANDING gives these objects a place in that story. Every landing leaves a story. Developed by Team GETAFFIE as an independent educational project. Not an official NASA product and not endorsed by NASA.
